title: 抑斋 Yi Zhai
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: No box in the 3D view: the plan shows no building here, or a plot, water, a hill or a name only.

evidence.title: 御製題抑齋
evidence.excerpt_zh: 乾隆七年御製題抑齋　忩紗浸緑鳥聲頻拂拂花香户外新座有蘭言文作篆壁留箏字額題銀偶然得句緣新意長自耽書是宿因慙愧當年齋内客劈箋煮茗一閒身
evidence.summary: Short poem on 抑齋, its window and plaque.

evidence.title: 御製抑齋詩
evidence.excerpt_zh: 乾隆三十九年御製抑齋詩　長春仙館中齋額泐青宫（長春仙館予為皇子時所居也顔書室曰抑齋與重華宫西廂同即位後凡園亭行館有可静憩觀書者率以押齋為額）到處兹數典坐來惟恧躬業修徳進未昔日此人同祇有抑然志庶幾如武公
evidence.summary: Late poem on 抑齋: named for his study as a prince in 長春仙館.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 长春仙馆
evidence.excerpt_zh: 長春仙館之西為含碧堂五楹堂後為林虚桂静左為古香齋其東楹有閣為抑齋林虚桂静東稍南為墨池雲後有殿為隨安室（圓明園冊）臣等謹按含碧堂諸額皆皇上御書
evidence.summary: West of 長春仙館: the five-bay 含碧堂, with 林虚桂静, 古香齋, 抑齋 in its east bay, 墨池雲, and 隨安室 at the rear.

evidence.title: 抑斋: 乾隆二十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆二十九年 (1764), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 青宫旧题额，懿戒儆怀吾。书室每仍以，初心敢忘乎。威仪审缜密，严正谨㢘隅。一再尊闻揆，惟増愧恧俱。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 抑斋, 1764, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 抑斋: 乾隆三十九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆三十九年 (1774), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 长春仙馆中，斋额泐青宫。（长春仙馆予为皇子时所居也。颜书室曰抑斋与重华宫西厢同。即位后凡园亭行馆有可静憩。观书者率以抑斋为额。 ）到处兹数典，坐来惟恧躬。业修德进未，昔日此人同。祗有抑然志，庶几如武公。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 抑斋, 1774, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 抑斋
evidence.locator: v2 p.66, under 长春仙馆; source ref 14-474
evidence.excerpt_zh: 昔读武公诗，书斋因额之。威仪德隅凛，敬慎远犹思。饬己臻尚未，治人艰可知。如云警既耄，将亦逮其时。正月廿三日，圣母忌辰，于长春仙馆礼佛作（14-484）未敢居然奉神御，
evidence.summary: Poem 抑斋 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1781, filed by the editors under 长春仙馆.

evidence.title: 抑斋: 乾隆四十八年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆四十八年 (1783), date from the compilation
evidence.excerpt_zh: 伯玉使人于孔子，嘉其改过未能乎。抑之六十余年者（予名此斋盖六十余年矣），试问学臻抑也无。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 抑斋, 1783, on reading. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 抑斋
evidence.locator: from p.173, under 长春仙馆
evidence.summary: Qianlong's study here as a prince; a note of 1774 says he reused the name in his other gardens. 抑斋: 5 dated items, 1764-1783, of which 5 poems (Qianlong); recurring themes: reading. First dated 1764, last dated 1783.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.
